scope: Explicitly audited unfinished terminal work and durable runtime interruption recovery

contract.admission: authorizeContinuation(thread, assessment) requires latest terminal turn, matching turnId, authorized and unfinished true, and nonempty evidence. Interrupted admission additionally requires runtimeInterrupted true.
contract.observation: observe(threadId, turn, assessment) may admit an explicitly assessed runtime interruption; an unassessed interruption remains conservative and cancels recovery.
contract.durability: Admission evidence, exact source turn, request identity, retry count and due time persist in SQLite. Runtime interruption within the chain preserves original source and accumulated retry budget.
contract.completion: Registered workers receive CONTINUATION_INPUT requiring scripts/task-checkpoint.mjs before terminal response. Continue checkpoints schedule the same durable chain; completed checkpoints finish; needsInput blocks. Missing checkpoint retains awaitingAssessment and never infers completion or starts a model polling loop.
contract.health: Existing runtime health, pending input, outgoing delivery, permissions, usage stops and quota reset checks remain required before dispatch. Start inherits existing model and permissions and sends the existing preserved-context recovery input. Native goal status is read through thread/goal/get; unavailable policy evidence delays recovery. Local data storage requires 64MiB available headroom.
contract.checkpoint: recordCheckpoint(thread,{turnId,state:continue|completed|needsInput,evidence}) requires exact latest accepted recovery turn. Durable per-turn receipts are immutable and duplicate-idempotent. Exact client request receipts may reconcile lost start acknowledgement without a second start.
contract.backoff: Total attempts remain diagnostic; independent durable backoff_attempts resets only on successful completed continuation progress. Failed/interrupted/health outages retain their sparse budget. Five successful chunks remain quick across restarts.
contract.context: Original audited authorization scope persists separately from subsequent worker progress checkpoints; prompt includes original scope plus latest evidence bounded to 8000 characters.
contract.failureIdentity: One-time legacy backfill excludes registered continuation chains. Only actual failed-turn observations add new failure IDs; completed partial/progress finals remain useful catch-up content.

verifiedCases: backoff budget retained through repeated interruption
new user work supersedes admitted continuation
worker continue checkpoint across partial finals
five quick successful progress chunks then sparse outage
completed partial finals never marked failed on restart
limits: Historical audit uses bounded rollout tails, not full semantic certification of every old goal.
Unassessed interruption may be an explicit stop; it is not blindly restarted.
Missing worker checkpoint remains awaitingAssessment rather than inferred complete or model-polled.
Physical recording/provider quality and final Android delivery are separate qualification.
No unrelated applications, external messages, charges or uncertain submissions were replayed.

integration.ownerOnlyAdmission: Reads exact latest native terminal turn; rejects managed children, outstanding input, uncertain outbox delivery and task usage stops.
integration.checkpoint: Owner-authenticated latest-turn checkpoint endpoint and local original-session helper integrated.
integration.liveAudit: Full native inventory including explicit subAgent pagination; bounded local transcript evidence and exact native reads before changes. Seven existing independent owners resumed; children and historical ambiguous tasks were preserved.
integration.restart: Five running continuation turn IDs preserved through controlled bridge-only restart; one due waiting continuation accepted once. Native daemon, pairing, outboxes and transcript ownership retained.
integration.realCheckpoints: Existing workers reported continue and automatically advanced. Jobsearcher reconciliation reported completed before a newer explicit user instruction superseded its chain.
integration.modelsAndPermissions: Continuation starts inherit existing native settings; no model or permission override.
integration.uncertainDelivery: Older coordinator outcomes inspected against native receipts; none blindly resent.

checks: IME-open volume-key capture and visible timer/error
nativeSmoke.environment: Owned API34 emulator and synthetic fixture; physical provider and hardware keys not requalified
nativeSmoke.galleryChecker: Registered isolated checker queued; no layout-success claim
